import numpy as np
from astropy.convolution import convolve, convolve_fft, Gaussian2DKernel

# Create test input: 10x10 array of ones (no NaN values)
ar = np.ones((10, 10))

# Create Gaussian kernel of size 5x5
gaussian = Gaussian2DKernel(1, x_size=5, y_size=5)

# Convolve with boundary='fill', fill_value=np.nan, preserve_nan=True
result_convolve = convolve(ar, gaussian, boundary='fill', fill_value=np.nan, preserve_nan=True)
result_convolve_fft = convolve_fft(ar, gaussian, boundary='fill', fill_value=np.nan, preserve_nan=True)

# Capture key metrics:
# 1. Whether result_convolve is all finite (1 = all finite, 0 = has NaN)
all_finite = int(np.all(np.isfinite(result_convolve)))
probe('result_convolve_all_finite', all_finite)

# 2. Count of NaN values in result_convolve (should be 0 for correct behavior)
nan_count = int(np.isnan(result_convolve).sum())
probe('result_convolve_nan_count', nan_count)

# 3. Whether result_convolve_fft is all finite (should always be 1)
fft_all_finite = int(np.all(np.isfinite(result_convolve_fft)))
probe('result_convolve_fft_all_finite', fft_all_finite)

# 4. Count of NaN values in result_convolve_fft (should be 0)
fft_nan_count = int(np.isnan(result_convolve_fft).sum())
probe('result_convolve_fft_nan_count', fft_nan_count)

# 5. Max absolute difference between convolve and convolve_fft (ignoring NaN differences)
# Mask out NaN values before computing difference
mask = np.isfinite(result_convolve) & np.isfinite(result_convolve_fft)
if np.any(mask):
    max_diff = float(np.max(np.abs(result_convolve[mask] - result_convolve_fft[mask])))
else:
    max_diff = np.nan
probe('max_diff_finite_values', max_diff)
